# codigate Provider

Manage a Codigate workspace (agents, apps, access, edge rules, identity providers, domains, service tokens, log export, branding, alert channels) through the workspace API /api/v1.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    codigate = {
      source  = "codigate/codigate"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Reads CODIGATE_API_TOKEN (and CODIGATE_API_URL) from the environment when not set here.
provider "codigate" {
  # api_url = "https://app.codigate.nl/api/v1"
  # token   = var.codigate_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the workspace API. Defaults to the CODIGATE_API_URL environment variable, then https://app.codigate.nl/api/v1.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Workspace API token (Settings → API tokens). A viewer token can only read; managing resources needs an admin token. Defaults to the CODIGATE_API_TOKEN environment variable.
